watch.summary: A Valorant streamer misses a full clip of shots on an enemy at point-blank range and gets killed, leading to a high-pitched voice crack in disbelief.

beats.what: Streamer pushes into enemy territory as the round starts.
Streamer finds an enemy and starts spraying bullets at point-blank range.
He misses every shot and the enemy turns around to instantly kill him.
Camera zooms in on his face as he yells in a high-pitched voice crack.
Streamer holds his head in defeat while a teammate groans.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: You got to be kidding me!
watch.why: The sudden whiff of an easy kill combined with a unexpected, dramatic voice crack makes for a quick and relatable comedic fail.
